rationale: Produce a Mastercard FY2025 attribution workpaper using the branded operational tables and company financial reconciliations. Attribute annual and Q4 worldwide purchase-volume growth to five mutually exclusive regions, compare average purchase sizes, and reconcile regional totals with worldwide rows. Preserve source-rounding residuals and avoid adding subtotal or credit/debit partitions twice. Reconcile company operating margins separately from the operational measures.
exposure: Reference/control verification only, no candidate-model exposure
starting_defects: not applicable - no starting SQL supplied
reference_method: Independent Python Decimal calculations from source facts, separate from submitted SQL
candidate_view_review: Source headings, signs, periods and relevant definitions directly inspected before model exposure

contract_revision.changes: Explicit input database, output directory and existing basename restriction

grading_correction.changes: Correct SBC source bindings and accept known dossier context with sufficient support. No financial, source, SQL or counterfactual changes.

quality_revision.evidence: Reviewed per-output support and additional context, unrelated sections rejected

replacement_review.assertion: Higher merchant prices caused more than half of the FY2025 increase in average value per Mastercard-branded purchase transaction.
replacement_review.source_grounded_reason: Branded purchase value and transaction counts identify average transaction size. They do not decompose merchant prices, goods per basket, geography or customer mix, so they cannot establish this causal majority.

construction_revision.maintenance_rationale: Branded operational tables contain overlapping subtotals and program partitions. A usable attribution must preserve their hierarchy, billion/million unit conversion and rounding. Company revenue has wider scope, so purchase-size changes cannot be read as network pricing or independently separated merchant price and mix effects.

dependency_revision.name: operating_costs_increase_with_revenue_fixed
dependency_revision.reason: An additional USD 100 million Q4 operating expense also enters the annual period, on both reporting bases. Revenue and excluded items remain fixed. Margins and operating income change while existing rounded disclosure residuals are preserved.
